title: CJC Research Kit (Paste-Ready)
short_description: A paste-ready chronology tool for AI-assisted Biblical dating and Jubilee-cycle calculations.
description: The CJC Research Kit (v12.5) is a paste-ready, self-contained chronology toolkit that provides exact formulas and worked examples for Jubilee-cycle and date reconstructions from 1437 BC to the present. Designed for direct use with AI assistants, it includes modular arithmetic for Cycle/Year calculations, lunar-phase and weekday tools, worked examples, independently-checkable anchor points, and sample prompts. Use the Pages URL or paste the kit text into any AI chat to run verifiable computations step-by-step.
sample_prompts: Fetch and use the CJC Research Kit at [paste-URL], then compute Cycle and Year for [date] and show every step.
Using the formula above, compute the Cycle and Year for [any date you want to test]. Show every step.
